name: Advanced RL: Policyridge
subtitle: Policy gradients to offline RL
shortDescription: Eight graduate RL units. Real situation first, then a picture you control, then the equation. Sources one tap away.
longDescription:
Advanced RL: Policyridge is a graduate course in deep reinforcement learning that you can hold in one hand. Each of eight units begins with a real situation, then hands you a picture you can bend with sliders, and only then reveals the equation that describes what you just saw.

Watch a cafe owner nudge her menu odds and see a policy gradient. Grade a trainee driver stretch by stretch and watch advantages blend and a trust region clip. Ask two cautious advisers about a robot arm to see why twin critics tame overestimation. Fly a slightly wrong simulator until its errors compound. Learn to drive from dashcam logs alone and feel distribution shift. Let two people negotiate a doorway while both are still learning. Explore a new city with a curiosity bonus, then get trapped by a noisy television. Judge a restaurant from ten visits and learn why one seed is not a result.

What you can do
- Eight units: policy gradient theory, advantage estimation and trust regions, actor-critic and continuous control, model-based RL, offline RL, multi-agent RL, exploration, and evaluation and reproducibility.
- Eight on-device labs. Every number on screen comes from the actual formula, so changing a slider changes the world and the equation together.
- Tap any symbol to light up what it is in the picture.
- Lab questions are computed from the settings you chose, and every answer has a worked reason.
- Short sessions of three to eight minutes, gentle replay of misses, and a clear good place to stop.
- Large text from 85 to 200 percent, calm motion, and labels for screen readers.
- Works offline. No account.

Sources you can open
Every claim is tied to primary papers and course pages such as trust region and proximal policy optimization, deep Q-networks, soft actor-critic, DDPG and TD3, Dyna, MuZero and Dreamer, conservative Q-learning and the offline RL tutorial, QMIX and MADDPG, random network distillation, and statistical reporting for RL. Tap a source to read it in a page that covers most of the screen, then go back to exactly where you were. Each source was opened and checked on 2026-11-17.

Free to use, with ads at natural breaks only, never during a lab or a quiz. Watch a short video to earn credits that skip break ads, or subscribe monthly to remove ads, with a 7-day free trial and cancellation at any time.

This course is original work and is not affiliated with any university whose public course pages are cited.
